avis.titre: Third bottle that stops working halfway through the bottle
avis.texte: I gave it two stars, because I do actually like the product. It has a fine mist that works great for misting my face before skincsre products. However, this is the third bottle in a row where the sprayer has stopped working halfway through the bottle. I have tried running it under warm water/scrubbing it, ect. Once the nozzle stops working, you can't use any of the product thats left inside. It is starting to feel purposeful now, so that you are forced to buy a new bottle even when you still have a lot left.

This is a million times better than any other thermal water spray out there. The mist is finer and the ingredients are much more soothing. Once you make the switch you won't got back! Make a jumbo size please!

Love this Mineralizing Thermal Water Spray! Great for after the shower before skin care routine, or on mornings where you need a quick refresh after washing your face. Lasts for a good deal of time and Vichy products have remained a good deal. This is a product that I've grown attached to and now can't do without.
First time I used it and I felt that it calmed my skin. I used it before putting on the hyaluronic acid, and my skin feels fresh.

Yes! What is in the can is refreshing to the skin, BUT I am now on my THIRD can that can not be sprayed because of a faulty nozzle. I actually was so frustrated with my money going to waste, that this morning I called the number for customer service in Canada and explained the issue. Answered all questions: where was purchased, mow much I paid, what size can, what was the lot number and expiry...then was told they would send me an email from which I would have to fill out a form with product info (I just gave them all that!!), send a photo, and possibly be asked to return the product for examination. This tells you the level of integrity of this company. What is the value of having a good product if it cant be dispensed? When I asked what would likely be done after filling out this form, she said they don't provide product replacements here in Canada, and wait and see what the company would do. I will never purchase anything from Vichy again

I love Vichy's Volcanic Water because it makes my skin hydrated yet toned. I usually use this as a final step in my skincare routine and just let it air dry. I also use it during winter and summer months throughout the day in extreme climates, or when my skin needs a refresh. I love it. This is perfect on those days when you feel extremely dehydrated and your face feels tight and dry. Just a few sprays and your back to hydrated radiance. I do not notice a smell or fragrance in this product. It does not cause any irritation or discomfort to any area of my face, including my eyes. This is a fantastic pick me up throughout the day. Be careful spraying it over some makeup because I did notice that it would disrupt my eyeshadow.

I gave it 2 stars because I like the thermal water, however I DO NOT RECOMMEND BUYING this product because the spray ceases to work half way through the bottle so you pay for full bottle but only get half. The company is well aware of this (see other reviews) but they will not fix the issue nor will they give you a refund. Not worth it.

Obviously, from reading reviews, many others have experienced the same issue. Please fix this problem Vichy.

I found that I just like using it before the other parts of my skincare routine. It seems like actives and moisturizers just absorb a little better after using this. To be clear, I had no complaints about the actual water. It was spring water, it's kind of hard to mess that up. BUT THE PACKAGING! Around the 60% used mark, the spout sprayer started to have some serious pressure issues - I'm talking weak, really dense streams of water instead of the fine mist I was expecting. By the time I'd used 80% of the bottle, the sprayer was completely non-functional. Given that this is a pressurized can of mist, that meant I had to throw out a solid 20% of my purchase because of packaging failure. I assume this was mineral deposits from the spring water slowly clogging up the sprayer, the same was hard water buildup can choke a shower head over time. Maybe I was just unlucky, but I just cannot recommend a thermal water with a busted sprayer.

I've seen this complaint around in some reviews online when I was trying to find a fix. Right now the only way to use it is if I hold down the nozzle and let the water build up, then pour it into my hand but that's messy and not ideal for what I purchased this for. avis.titre: Year Round - Makeup finisher - Workout cooler
avis.texte: This is one of those items that has various uses. For me, the fine mist is wonderful year round. In the dry, winter air sometimes my skin feels parched. I apply my moisturizer after a shower every day. But throughout the day I notice my skin drying out. A quick spray on my face, arms, and down my legs makes me feel SO refreshed! The skin nurturing water goes beyond feeling great. It's packed with minerals that works to keep your skin healthy. Come summertime, what would be better than a super fine, cooling mist on your face? A step way above splashing tap water all over your body mid-day. After applying makeup, my normally oily facial skin starts feeling coated and heavy, no matter how light I apply it. A quick spray is a surprising product to not only set my makeup, but to add wonderful minerals this spray provides in its thermal water. So how could you lose with this impressive product? Reminds me of a magical youth water in a spray! You can't deny your skin that!
